parameter.label: EMPRESA : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT EMP.CODEMP AS VALUE, EMP.CODEMP || '- '||EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP EMP ORDER BY 1

simple-value.expression:
SELECT SUM(RECEITA) AS RECEITA,SUM(DESPESA) AS DESPESA,SUM(RESULTADO) AS RESULTADO FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS RECEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS RESULTADO
FROM TGFFIN FIN INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON FIN.CODNAT= NAT.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFMBC MBC ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO LEFT JOIN TSICTA CTA ON CTA.CODCTABCOINT = MBC.CODCTABCOINT
WHERE FIN.DHBAIXA >= :PERIODO.INI AND FIN.DHBAIXA <= :PERIODO.FIN AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND FIN.PROVISAO='N' AND FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((CTA.CLASSE IS NULL OR CTA.CLASSE <> 'D')) AND FIN.CODEMP IN :EMPRESA
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS RECEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS RESULTADO FROM TGFMBC MBC INNER JOIN TSICTA CTA ON MBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON FIN.CODNAT= NAT.CODNAT WHERE MBC.DTLANC >= :PERIODO.INI AND MBC.DTLANC < :PERIODO.FIN AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND CTA.CLASSE = 'D' AND (FIN.CODEMP IN :EMPRESA) AND :ADIANTAMENTO = 'S')
simple-value.value-expression: Resultado: $RESULTADO Receita Total: $RECEITA Despesa Total: $DESPESA

chart.expression:
SELECT SUM(RECEITA) AS RECEITA, SUM(DESPESA) AS DESPESA, PER,ORDEM,SUM(AZUL) AS AZUL, SUM(VERMELHO) AS VERMELHO FROM( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS RECEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, TO_CHAR(FIN.DHBAIXA,'Mon/YYYY') AS PER, TO_CHAR(FIN.DHBAIXA,'YYYYMM') AS ORDEM, case when
SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) >0 then SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) end as AZUL,
case when
SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) <=0 then SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) end as VERMELHO FROM TGFFIN FIN INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON FIN.CODNAT= NAT.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFMBC MBC ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO LEFT JOIN TSICTA CTA ON CTA.CODCTABCOINT = MBC.CODCTABCOINT WHERE FIN.DHBAIXA >= :PERIODO.INI AND FIN.DHBAIXA <= :PERIODO.FIN AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND FIN.PROVISAO='N' AND FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((CTA.CLASSE IS NULL OR CTA.CLASSE <> 'D')) AND (FIN.CODEMP IN :EMPRESA) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(FIN.DHBAIXA,'Mon/YYYY') , TO_CHAR(FIN.DHBAIXA,'YYYYMM')
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS RECEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, TO_CHAR(MBC.DTLANC,'Mon/YYYY') AS PER, TO_CHAR(MBC.DTLANC,'YYYYMM') AS ORDEM, case when
SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) >0 then SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) end as AZUL,
case when
SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) <=0 then SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) end as VERMELHO FROM TGFMBC MBC INNER JOIN TSICTA CTA ON MBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON FIN.CODNAT= NAT.CODNAT WHERE MBC.DTLANC >= :PERIODO.INI AND MBC.DTLANC < :PERIODO.FIN AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND CTA.CLASSE = 'D' AND (FIN.CODEMP IN :EMPRESA) AND :ADIANTAMENTO = 'S' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(MBC.DTLANC,'Mon/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(MBC.DTLANC,'YYYYMM')) GROUP BY PER,ORDEM ORDER BY 4
